research_claim: Underdense regions surrounding a galaxy generate a compressive differential field that is weak at the center and increases the centripetal acceleration of exterior tracers.

source_definition.reason: Use only resolved CF4 cells exterior to one voxel around the galaxy and limit the source to an eight-voxel surrounding shell. No rotation residual enters the source construction.

inverse_square_null.prediction: The isotropic compressive trace is exactly zero outside sources by the shell theorem.

power_law_primary.unit_hessian: H = integral q_v dV [(p+1) n n^T - I] / d^(p+1)

models.screened_radial_environment: v_pred^2 = v_bar^2 + V_0^2 E_i^m r^2/[r^2+(c_R R_d)^2]
models.environment_definition: E_i is the positive unit-strength compressive trace divided by the training-fold median.

validation.fold_balance: rank-balanced on the primary geometry score
validation.heldout_nuisance_rule: catalog distances and inclinations with fixed declared stellar mass-to-light ratios; no heldout velocity enters optimization

stop_rules.direct_cage: Reject a literal external cage if the harmonic environment model does not materially improve heldout predictions over its geometry-blind counterpart.
stop_rules.screened_cage: Reject the tested screened conversion if it fails any primary success gate; do not repair it by assigning per-galaxy cage amplitudes, centers, ranges, or mass-class switches.
stop_rules.void_origin: Withhold a void-origin claim if the environment-dependent model does not beat the identical radial model with E_i=1 and shuffled-environment controls.
stop_rules.unification: Withhold a galaxy-lensing unification claim unless parameters fitted without lensing predict theory-neutral raw lensing observables for at least ten same systems.

known_identifiability_limits: CF4 resolves approximately 7.8125 h100^-1 Mpc cells, not the galaxy-scale screening boundary.
SPARC supplies one-dimensional rotation curves and cannot test the predicted void-aligned velocity dipole.
The screened radial shape is halo-degenerate unless its amplitude is predicted by independent void geometry.
Current CLASH acceleration summaries are GR/NFW-derived rather than raw theory-neutral lensing likelihoods.
The current public same-system audit has zero strict-ready systems and cannot identify a population relation between Phi and Phi+Psi.
